messages.充電を貯めながらS2「跳躍」を主力に戦い、充電が貯まったらS3「次・魔・空・切」: A Slash attacker that mainly uses S2 Leap while building Charge, then spends it on S3 D.D.E.D.R. for heavy damage. Much of her strength comes from Coin Power, so her performance varies greatly with SP.
messages.S2「跳躍」: 使用時に充電回数が5/6/7増加。充電回数10以上でコイン威力+: **S2 — Leap**: Increases Charge Count by 5/6/7 on use. +1 Coin Power at 10 or more Charge Count, and +1 more at 15 or more. Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1/2 Slash Fragility with at least 10 Charge. Coin Ⅲ deals +15/20/30% damage to targets below 30% HP and grants 1/3 Haste next turn on defeating an enemy.
messages.S3「次・魔・空・切」: 充電回数15以上なら15を消耗してコイン威力+3/5。: **S3 — D.D.E.D.R.**: With 15 or more Charge Count, spends 15 for +3/5 Coin Power. With 7–14, spends all of it and pays HP equal to 3×(15 − Charge Count spent)% of max HP for +3/5 Coin Power. At 6 or less, there is neither a bonus nor an HP cost. Only when 15 was spent, Coin Ⅳ grants 5/7 Charge Barrier to herself and 1 ally on defeating an enemy.
messages.S1「エ・循」: 3コイン。Ⅰ・Ⅱコインの的中時に充電回数が2ずつ増加。充電10: **S1 — E.C.**: 3 Coins. On hit, Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each increase Charge Count by 2. +10% damage each at 10 or more and 15 or more Charge.
messages.充電: 最大20、ターン終了時に1減少。: **Charge**: Maximum 20; decreases by 1 at Turn End.
messages.バトルパッシブ「次元魔剣」(傲慢×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 敵討伐時に充電回: **Combat passive — Dimensional Demon Edge (5 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Increases Charge Count by 2/3 on defeating an enemy, up to 3 times per turn.
messages.S1は充電をⅠ・Ⅱコインの的中時に得るので、コインが当たらないと稼げない。マッチ: S1 gains Charge on hit with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, so it gains nothing if the Coins do not land. It is better suited to landing one-sided attacks for Charge than to Clashing. Build Clashes and damage around S2. Using it when slightly short of a threshold is efficient, since its on-use increase pushes Charge over the line. S3 reaches full output at 15 Charge, but can still be fired at 7–14 by paying HP. That HP cost can be treated as a resource. Her HP is low, so use it when she has HP to spare.
